users: researchers and engineers building surrogates from configured ANSYS Fluent studies
supported_tasks: generate a CFD design of experiments
not_intended_for: an accuracy claim outside the documented geometry, physics, mesh, solver settings, output definitions, and design space

outputs: predictions within a declared design space

limitations: A trained surrogate requires case-specific evaluation and does not establish extrapolation accuracy.
The workflow requires a working ANSYS Fluent installation and case-specific solver configuration.
